name: Camping Biberhof
beschreibung: The Camping Biberhof is located in the village of Biberwier on the Fernpass in Tirol at an altitude of around 1,000 meters. The facility includes pitches for campers with motorhome, caravan, or tent, all of which are available with an electricity connection. The sanitary building offers separate showers and toilets as well as a baby changing room. A children's playground and a table tennis area offer opportunities for leisure activities. The campsite has its own reception with information on excursion destinations in the region. In winter, the ski areas of Ehrwald and Lermoos can be reached within a few minutes by car. The location directly on the Fernpassstraße provides good connections for travelers passing through.
